name: cp_sat_direct_integer
steps: declare non-negative INTEGER variables X (budget on channel X) and Y (budget on channel Y)
encode C1 budget cap: X + Y <= 1000
encode C2 effectiveness requirement: 2*X + 3*Y >= 2000 (literal coefficients 2 and 3 from the task text)
minimize the linear cost 10*X + 20*Y (unit costs $10 for X, $20 for Y) with OR-Tools CP-SAT as an exact integer solver
report optimal objective value and the (X, Y) allocation

name: milp_highs_direct
steps: declare non-negative INTEGER variables X and Y
encode C1 budget cap: X + Y <= 1000
minimize 10*X + 20*Y with the HiGHS MIP solver at zero MIP gap
report proven optimum and the (X, Y) allocation
